rv.q: Little wonder Sarah Mantell’s drama nabbed the prestigious Susan Blackburn Prize for 2023, which recognizes works by women+ playwrights. If Mantell’s mournful In the Amazon Warehouse Parking Lot is scarcely a crowd-pleaser, it is a sensitively crafted drama commissioned and produced by Playwrights Horizons, where its world premiere opened Monday.
A tantalizingly dark premise, it proves to be merely drab under the slack direction of Sivan Battat, dulled further by listless performances.
